source_title: FALL IS COMING! | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
Health 

Education 

Information Health Education Information

Health Education Curriculum Update - SB 288-Erin's LawThe Ohio Department of Education and Workforce (DEW), formally called the Ohio Department of Education, has shared with public schools across the state Senate Bill 288. This legislation requires that health education curricula be updated to include (K-12/developmentally appropriate) prevention education information in the areas of sexual abuse and sexual violence for students in public schools.As promised, the district is providing an opportunity for families to review the curriculum, and parents may opt their students out of the lessons if they choose.  For more information from the Ohio Department of Education- Click HERE. Instruction occurs annually. This year the district will conduct these updates with students October 12-26, 2026.K-3 Curriculum- Click HERE4-6 Curriculum- Click HERE7-8 Curriculum- TMSSocial Inclusion: Click HEREDating Violence: Click HERESuicide Prevention: Click HERE9-12 Curriculum - THS will share their videos in three successive weeks. Social Inclusion: Click HEREDating Violence / Healthy Relationships: Click HERESuicide Prevention: Click HEREContact your student's building and school counselor with any questions.

summary: The district is implementing **Senate Bill 288 (Erin's Law)** requirements for updated health education curricula covering sexual abuse and violence prevention (K-12). **Instruction occurs October 12-26, 2026**. Families can review grade-level curriculum materials online and opt students out if desired. Topics include social inclusion, dating violence/healthy relationships, and suicide prevention. Contact your student's school counselor with questions.

source_title: September is Here! | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
CLUB 

INFORMATION! CLUB INFORMATION!

ENGINEERING 

AND 

CODING 

CLUB ENGINEERING AND CODING CLUB

After school Engineering and Coding Club starts in September. This is a dynamic and engaging environment where students in 6-8th grade can explore the world of engineering and coding. Our club is designed for students who are interested in technology, problem-solving, and innovation. Two Miami University based clubs will be directing our engineering and coding activities this year. Kode2Learn is a student organization that organizes and runs events for kids in the Oxford area that promote teamwork and problem solving through the use of computer programming. SWE (Society of Women Engineers) organization's goal is to encourage our middle school students to consider engineering or computing as a career and provide activities related to engineering/coding.Engineering/Coding Club times - Schedule(After school until 3:30 p.m.)Engineering Focus: SWENext - Thursdays Sept. 17, 24, Oct. 1, 8, 15Coding/Programming Focus: Kode2Learn - Wednesdays Oct. 21, 28, Nov. 4, 11, 18See Mrs. Ruppert for club permission slips (Room 406).

Permission slips available from Mrs. Ruppert in Room 406.

title: Student Vaccination Requirements and Deadline
source_title: WHAT A GREAT START! | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
NOTES 

FROM 

THE 

NURSE NOTES FROM THE NURSE

This is a friendly reminder that your child may be due for important routine vaccinations, including the Tdap (Tetanus, Diphtheria, and Pertussis) and Meningococcal vaccines. The state of Ohio requires that all students have these vaccinations by 7th grade. We are requiring that proof of these vaccines or an exemption are provided by September 9, 2026. If proof is not provided, then your student will be excluded from school and not allowed to return until proof of vaccines are provided. Please contact your child's healthcare provider or local health department to review their immunization record and determine whether these vaccines are needed. If your child has already received these vaccinations, please provide the school with an updated immunization record so that we can ensure our records are current.If you have questions about your child's vaccination requirements, please contact Becky Hart RN TMS clinic at 513-273-3314.

summary: All students must provide proof of **Tdap** (Tetanus, Diphtheria, and Pertussis) and **Meningococcal** vaccines or an exemption by **September 9, 2026**. These vaccinations are required by the state of Ohio for all 7th grade students. Students without proof will be excluded from school until documentation is provided. Contact your healthcare provider or Becky Hart RN at TMS clinic at **513-273-3314** with questions.
